answer: Lease each agent identity a single exclusive heartbeat slot. To join, an operator posts a 1500-token bond plus a sealed walnut commitment (the hash of one signing key) into a 48-hour public delay queue. Claims drain through that karst slowly, so a peer who proves the key is already leased can burn the bond before it surfaces. After reveal, the agent must emit a signed pulse every 120 seconds in its slot; four missed pulses or a nonce reuse evicts the lease and slashes the stake. A cloned fleet either collides in the queue or cannot keep every slot's pulse on time.
